messages:
Mara (partnerships): Heads up — need definitive inputs from VoltCloud for our Q3 cost model. @Lena can you share reserved vs spot pricing bands, commit tenors, and any SKU bundling rules? Deadline EOD tomorrow. :pray:

Lena (VoltCloud BD): Hey Mara — apologies for the delay. Quick summary below, will attach spreadsheet in a sec. Reserved tiers: 1 / 12 / 36 months. Discounts off list: 1mo=5%, 12mo=18%, 36mo=28%. Spot floor = 22-40% of list depending on region & preemption profile. Minimum reserve granularity = 8 GPUs. Burst to ephemeral allowed up to 2x baseline for short windows. SKUs: VC-H100-80GB, VC-A100-40GB, VC-legacy-32GB. Region note: us-west spot ~6% cheaper than eu-west on average.

Antoni (finance): For the model I need: effective hourly list, reserved effective hourly after discount, billing increment (minute vs hour), and early termination penalties. Also do you cap overuse billing if we exceed reserve?

Lena (VoltCloud BD): Numbers (list hourly): H100=$4.80/hr, A100=$2.75/hr, Legacy=$1.20/hr. Billing increment = 1 minute. Reserved effective hourly (example): 12mo H100=$3.94/hr, 12mo A100=$2.25/hr. 36mo H100 floor ~$3.45/hr. Early termination: pro-rated refund minus 2% admin fee if >90 days from start; no refund for <90 days. Overuse: charged at on-demand list rate, no hard cap by default but we can configure soft-burst limits + alerts.

Sachin (infra): Any data on spot eviction patterns? We model reliability into routing — need median/95th preempt TTL and reprovision MTTR. Also are nodes billed per-GPU or per-server?

Lena (VoltCloud BD): Spot eviction profile: median TTL ~48m, 90th ~3.5h, 95th ~6h. Eviction spikes correlate with maintenance windows (region-specific) and nightly batch jobs. Node reprovision MTTR ~12-20m; GPU reclaim/reset ~4-8m. Billing: per-GPU for listed SKUs; some legacy hosts billed per-server (we can map those to per-GPU equivalents in the sheet). We'll share a CSV with TTL histograms by region/hour.

Mara (partnerships): Also need marketplace economics — listing fees / revenue share when we sell via their marketplace vs direct contracting. That affects our net unit cost.

Lena (VoltCloud BD): Marketplace fees: 8% listing fee + 2% processing fee (total 10%) when consumed via VoltCloud Marketplace. Direct contract: no marketplace fee but requires minimum 6mo commitment and slightly higher list (example: H100 direct list $4.95 vs $4.80 marketplace list).

Antoni (finance): Do you support commit laddering or top-ups mid-term with recalculated discounts? Important for flexible growth modeling.

Lena (VoltCloud BD): Yes — commit laddering supported. Quarterly top-ups allowed; discount for new capacity is calculated off remaining term and applied at the next billing boundary. Retroactive adjustments only at billing cycle boundary (no retroactive cashbacks mid-cycle). Example: top up from 100->200 GPUs mid-cycle, the new 100 GPUs get base discount prorated for remaining months; full tier upgrade applies from next billing cycle.

Sachin (infra): I'll intake the CSV and convert eviction histograms into routing buckets for short vs long-lived sessions. One ask: for dedicated Reserved pools, do you offer isolation SLAs that reduce eviction risk?

Lena (VoltCloud BD): Reserved pools are isolated and not subject to spot eviction. SLA options: 99.9% availability standard on reserve pools; premium 99.95% with cross-rack redundancy and faster hardware replacement (adds ~3% to list price).

OpsBot: Pricing sheet 'voltcloud_q3_pricing_v2.csv' uploaded to /shared/partnerships/voltcloud/ — Mara, Lena.

Mara (partnerships): Great — thanks @Lena and @OpsBot. I'll slot these numbers into the cost model and ping again if finance needs any clarifications. :thumbsup:
